report_name: Local Cycling and Walking Infrastructure Plan 2024 - 2034
how_pct_was_used: The PCT was used to establish desire lines for cycle movements by identifying plausible route options where investment could have the most influence and impact, helping to inform the draft network map.
other_tools_developed: Walking Route Audit Tool (WRAT) and a 12-indicator scoring matrix for cycling routes and 10-indicator scoring matrix for walking routes.
specific_evidence_of_impact: The LCWIP process has identified a prioritised programme of infrastructure improvements, including tier one cycle routes such as the Warwick Road corridor (£5.5m) and the B582 Next HQ to Fox Hunter Roundabout corridor (£7.82m), and has established a framework for future investment and integration into the Blaby District Local Plan.
pct_usage_quote: We have employed the Propensity to Cycle Tool to support with establishing desire lines for cycle movements in the District of Blaby.
